sources.use: Station order, mandatory Owakudani transfer, approximate ten-minute sections, and operating-condition caveats
Station transfer relationship and current visitor facilities
Reservation requirement and official approximate forty-minute trail duration
Gas-related riding cautions and possibility of suspension

generalizations: Station spacing is schematic and does not represent distance, elevation, or a live timetable
About ten minutes is the operator's approximation for each ropeway section, not a connection guarantee
The 45–60, 75–95, and 90–120 minute windows are LazyTravel planning ranges, not operator promises
The booked-trail window protects check-in and delay buffer around the official approximately forty-minute walk; a meal needs additional time
Public overlook access, ropeway riding, and reserved-trail entry have different operating and health conditions
During closure or gas restrictions, follow staff and rebuild the route from the last open hub rather than forcing the loop

notes: Full-size labels, B6 composition, and the 390 px scroll-and-zoom viewport passed visual review.
